title: Balanced Loss Function for Accurate Surface Defect Segmentation
mechanism: Dynamic class weighting, truncated cross-entropy that drops well-classified pixels, and label-confusion suppression that caps the very large loss at defect borders caused by ambiguous labels.
adaptation: Apply border suppression to a 1 px band each side of crack labels (half of label points sit >1 px off the ridge), truncated CE at p > 0.9 on background, dynamic weights on the 12 defect classes to help gridline / splice / edge_dark.
evidence: R: KSDD2, Severstal and an aluminium set across several CNNs, IoU +5% to +30% (abstract; single runs as far as visible). Exact thresholds not read.
min_experiment: Arm: house with 1 px border suppression + truncated CE (0.9) + dynamic class weights; baseline: house; metric: CV crack IoU and mIoU_rob; kill if both gains < +0.01.
prior_overlap: Partial: offset-tolerant CE (n.d.) also tolerates border error; truncation and dynamic class weighting untested.
